dataset.name: FUNSD
dataset.declaredLicense: FUNSD non-commercial research/education terms; source image rights remain separate; local evaluation only
dataset.executionSubset: first page in pinned manifest, first 16 valid words in manifest order; selected before recognition
dataset.imagingQualityLabels: low_resolution_noisy_scanned_forms_by_source_description; no per-image severity or degradation-type labels

disjointParentEvidence.boundary: Page-disjoint from the prior controlled enhancement experiment; not a guarantee of absence from pretraining or unrelated OCR tests. No threshold is calibrated on these pages.

environment.cpuPowerPolicy: 电源方案 GUID: 85d583c5-cf2e-4197-80fd-3789a227a72c  (均衡模式)
environment.clockControl: not set by this test; no during-run clock telemetry

protocol.execution: recognizer-only over all valid source-labelled word quadrilaterals; detector bypassed
protocol.pageTiming: one measured invocation per page; diagnostic only, not a formal 5+50 performance benchmark
protocol.pairedCostTiming: 5 warm-up pairs + 50 measured pairs per backend; alternating baseline/enhancement order; fixed 16 word quadrilaterals on one preloaded input; includes crop/REC/CTC/retry, excludes file decode/input preparation/model/session setup

consensusThresholdAnalysis.mode: post-hoc exhaustive sweep over every distinct positive runtime-selected candidate confidence gain; reported cut points retain at least one candidate, thresholding only removes selections and never reselects a different candidate
consensusThresholdAnalysis.boundary: Post-hoc scan on this same fixed labelled sample; it is not an independent validation split and must not be used to select a production threshold.

pairedCost.boundary: RecognizeOnlyAsync on a preloaded page and fixed quadrilaterals; independently created single-session baseline and enhanced pipelines, batch 16. Timing includes crop/REC/CTC/retry, excludes page preparation/file I/O/DET/CLS/session setup. No forced GC or clock control; one device and one subset, not quality or a business-cost gate.

consensusThresholdAnalysis.mode: post-hoc exhaustive sweep over every distinct positive runtime-selected candidate confidence gain; reported cut points retain at least one candidate, thresholding only removes selections and never reselects a different candidate
consensusThresholdAnalysis.boundary: Post-hoc scan on this same fixed labelled sample; it is not an independent validation split and must not be used to select a production threshold.

pairedCost.boundary: RecognizeOnlyAsync on a preloaded page and fixed quadrilaterals; independently created single-session baseline and enhanced pipelines, batch 16. Timing includes crop/REC/CTC/retry, excludes page preparation/file I/O/DET/CLS/session setup. No forced GC or clock control; one device and one subset, not quality or a business-cost gate.

detailedRegionEvidence.scope: Full per-region metrics and text hashes retained as local test artifacts; not included in the repository summary.

boundary: Paired 5+50 recognition-only cost on one predeclared 16-word FUNSD crop selection. Timing includes source-region crop preparation, REC, CTC and optional three-recipe enhancement retry; excludes page input preparation, DET, CLS, file I/O, model/session setup. This is not full-page latency, quality approval, a business latency budget, cross-device or clock-locked performance.
